resources.string: Official warnings that mention your district
Enter a district name or use your location to see alerts.
Could not read your district from GPS. Type the district name instead.
Location permission is needed to detect your district. You can also type it.
No internet connection. Showing alerts saved on this device.

No official alert mentions %1$s in the current feed.
Showing saved alerts, they may be outdated

IMD district warnings are not connected yet. FloodCue needs an IMD API key, and IMD binds each key to one server address, so the key must stay on your own server (see server/README.md). SACHET alerts below work without it.
The IMD data source did not answer. Try Refresh later.
Paste the address of the imd_proxy.php file you uploaded (see server/README.md). Leave empty to hide IMD data. The IMD key is never stored on the phone.
IMD has no warning row for this district name right now.
The proxy answered but the data could not be read. Check the proxy setup.
River levels and flood forecasts come from the Central Water Commission. FloodCue does not receive them as live data, so open the official CWC portal to check them.
Could not open the link in a browser.

These are official warnings as published by IMD and NDMA SACHET. They are not a live flood sensor: rainfall warnings alone do not confirm flooding. Follow instructions from local authorities and disaster-management teams.
Loud official flood and heavy-rain warnings: plays the FloodCue siren, vibrates, and appears over other apps even when FloodCue is closed
